ENTREPRENEURSHIP / Founder

Hamzury Holding

Businesses need connected support to move from an idea to dependable operation. Hamzury Holding brings together specialist ventures across compliance, branding, software, automation, skills and partnerships.

The focus is practical business architecture: understand the challenge, organise the work and make delivery more consistent.

EDUCATION & OPPORTUNITY / Chairman

Rural Innovation and Digital Literacy Initiative (RIDLI)

Access to learning should not depend only on what a young person can afford. RIDLI connects sponsorship, digital literacy and practical training with opportunities to build.

More than 1,808 youth sponsored and trained, as reported by Haruna Muhammad. Programme dates, beneficiary records and outcome breakdowns are being compiled. This is a reported reach figure, not a verified employment or income result.

LEARNING THROUGH PRACTICE / Education & institution building

Hamzury Innovation Hub

The gap between learning a skill and using it matters. The Hub connects technical learning, entrepreneurship, mentoring and supervised practical work.

The intended progression is from understanding to useful work, with demonstrations, feedback and evidence of learning.

CIVIC TECHNOLOGY / Project & technical work

YEGO

Civic participation needs accessible ways to organise information and report what people observe. YEGO is election-focused platform work around participation and reporting.

Project status: technical development. Deployment, adoption and election outcomes are not presented here as independently verified results.

FAMILY HISTORY / Software project

Family Tree

Family knowledge can become fragmented across generations. This project explores organising relationships and preserving lineage in a more accessible form.

Project record: detailed case study and release information to follow.

HEALTH KNOWLEDGE / Exploratory concept

Shifa AI

An exploration of how technology could help people understand health information. Any future product needs reliable evidence, clinical review and appropriate safeguards.

Exploratory work. It is not a source of treatment recommendations or a substitute for a qualified clinician.

THINKING & RESEARCH / Developing framework

ASSSS

A five-stage approach to understanding challenges, choosing action, organising responsibility, building processes and examining results.

A developing body of thought. The library includes an essay, a teaching guide and a proposed research study; no scientific validation is claimed.
